name: Anthony Algorithm - Relics (东尼算法 - 遗物)
author: omp
description: A faithful reimplementation of the Anthony algorithm (Alriph's Auto-Anthonyology) applied to RELICS: relic behaviors extracted from the game's own relic implementations are split into independent trigger and effect fragments, then re-sampled and recombined per run seed, so any legal trigger can end up attached to any legal effect. Only hand-audited fragments (a deny-by-default evidence ledger) enter the generation pool. The recombination mechanism follows Alriph's Auto-Anthonyology (mod id AutoAnthony); the relic atom data was extracted from Slay the Spire 2's own relic classes by this mod's tooling; the generator, host and rendering are an independent reimplementation. Standalone; no AutoAnthony dependency. Coexists with Qurious Crafting - Relics.
